faq.a: We use MediaPipe Face Detection running entirely in your browser. Faces are detected locally and never uploaded to any server.
Three modes: Blur (Gaussian blur), Pixelate (mosaic effect), and Black Bar (solid black rectangle over faces).
Yes —since all processing happens in your browser, no personal data is transmitted. This is the most privacy-friendly way to anonymize photos.

faq.q: Can I adjust which faces are blurred?
faq.a: Currently all detected faces are blurred. You can adjust the padding to include more or less area around each face.
